content.text:
I added narrationLevel with the choices off, brief and detailed, but the check script reports one failure, and it isn't in my change. It's a qmllint warning in Chats.qml at line 509, which I didn't touch, saying the member "text" isn't found on a type. I didn't try to fix it.

The setting is wired in all three places. The manifest declares it in the schema and the defaults, with brief as the default. The daemon defaults in runtime.py include it, with a TOML alias under ui. The Voice page has a segmented control for it, next to the live transcript control, because that page owns spoken output.

The three checks for this setting pass, and all 1393 tests pass. Nothing reads narrationLevel yet, so the setting is stored and shown but doesn't change what the agent says. I haven't committed anything.
